title: 📚 *GDB — CS301*
text:
📚 *GDB — CS301*

*CS301 – GDB IDEA SOLUTION*

*Operation:* Product Management
*Data Structure:* Linked List
*Reason:* Since products keep getting added and removed all the time we need something flexible that can grow or shrink easily A linked list does not need a fixed size like an array so it fits this need perfectly

*Operation:* Product Search
*Data Structure:* Binary Search Tree
*Reason:* Because customers search using product IDs we need a structure that makes finding things fast A Binary Search Tree organizes data in a way that lets us skip half the records at each step while searching so it finds the product much quicker than checking one by one

*Operation:* Order Processing
*Data Structure:* Queue
*Reason:* Orders need to be handled in the exact order they come in (First In, First Out), and a queue naturally works this way whoever enters first gets served first, just like a line of customers at a counter.

*Operation:* Recently Viewed Products
*Data Structure:* Stack
*Reason:* Here we want the newest viewed item to show up first (Last In, First Out) and a stack does exactly that the last product added is the first one that comes out like stacking plates and taking the top one off first.
